question:
I want to extend the task of Agentbench. My task is a mobile operation task, implemented using an Android virtual device. When setting up this task, it is necessary to consider that each AVD occupies a large amount of memory and needs to control the concurrency based on the remaining memory of the machine; And AVD needs to be restarted after each test case to prevent mutual influence between tasks. Which of the following operations have errors:

Options:
(A) Inherit the Task class and change self.name to my task name
(B) When the start_stample function starts executing, consider the system memory situation and only start the test when there is sufficient remaining memory, otherwise wait
(C) Exit AVD in the release function and end testing Docker
(D) Calculate each test result in calculate_overall and return the result in JSON format

Select the single best option (A, B, C, or D) based strictly on the provided document(s). Give your final answer in the form 'Answer: <letter>' (where <letter> is A, B, C, or D).

1203| The Client primarily comprises three components:
1204| 
1205| - The Assigner is responsible for coordinating the concurrent tasks and models currently available, planning and
1206|   allocating test cases, and creating the corresponding number of Workers along with their Agent Client and Task Client.
1207| - The Agent Client implements the corresponding interface required by the Agent Server, exposing the

1214| graph, an s-node and t-node are constructed. The capacity of edges from s to the Agent represents the Agent's
1215| concurrency, while the capacity of edges from Task to t represents the Task's concurrency. The edge capacity between
1216| Agents and Tasks signifies the number of test cases awaiting evaluation. The Assigner's core allocation logic operates
1217| in real-time on this graph, using a maximum flow algorithm. Whenever an Agent or Task becomes available, the algorithm
1218| runs to produce a flow graph. Based on the flow on edges from Agent to Task, the corresponding number of workers are
